sanskrit: viṣāṇāsyāṅgirasī devajāḥ praticakṣaṇī | divas pṛthivyāḥ saṃbhūtā sahasrākṣīhaidhi naḥ ||
english: O horn-faced one, of Āṅgirasa descent, born of the gods, all-perceiving — born of heaven and earth, O Thousand-eyed one, be here for us.

sanskrit: sahasrākṣī yā tu gṛbhā- -ati paśyāsy oṣadhe | sadānvāghnī rakṣoghnī bhaveha praticakṣaṇī ||
english: O thousand-eyed herb, thou who seest beyond the snare — ever flame-armed, slayer of demons, be here as our all-perceiving one.

sanskrit: ye haranty āsuteyaṃ payasphātiṃ cauṣadhe | tāṃs tvaṃ sahasracakṣo gṛbhāya kṛtavīrye ||
english: Those who steal away the freshly pressed libation and the abundance of milk, O herb — seize thou them, O Thousand-eyed one, O thou of proven might.

sanskrit: ya āturaṃ randhayante 'rṣmantaṃ ca vihṛtam | tāṃs tvaṃ sahasracakṣo gṛbhāya kṛtavīrye ||
english: Those who deliver the afflicted one into ruin and the wounded man who is exposed — seize thou them, O Thousand-eyed one, O thou of proven might.

sanskrit: yathāśvā caturakṣo rātriṃ naktātipaśyati | evā sahasracakṣo tvaṃ prati paśyāsy āyataḥ ||
english: As the four-eyed horse sees through the night in darkness, so dost thou, O Thousand-eyed one, look forward upon him who approaches.

sanskrit: gobhir aśvair vasubhir apakrītāsy oṣadhe | śyāvasyāśvasya cakṣuṣā prati paśya kimīdinaḥ ||
english: Purchased with cows, with horses, with riches art thou, O herb. With the eye of the dark horse, look upon the demons, the Kimīdins.

sanskrit: saṃ sacadhvaṃ saṃ pibadhvam annaṃ vo madhumat saha | vrataṃ vaḥ sarvaṃ sadhryak samānaṃ ceto astu vaḥ ||
english: Come together, drink together; let your food be sweet and shared. Let all your vows be unanimously the same; let your minds be of one accord.

sanskrit: saṃ jānīdhvam indraś cettā vo 'stv ayaṃ vo 'gnir ni haraḥ śamayāti | yad vairahatyam uta bhīmam āsīd viśve devā apa tat plāvayantu ||
english: Be of one mind; let Indra be your common guide; let this Agni, the carrier downward, bring peace to you. Whatever hostility, whatever terror there was — may all the gods wash that away.

sanskrit: śaṃ vaḥ syāstu bṛhaspatiḥ śaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe | śam antarikṣam uta vo marutvān śaṃ vaḥ syāstv aditir devaputrā ||
english: May Bṛhaspati be well-being for you; may both heaven and earth be well-being; may the atmosphere too, and the Marutvān, be well-being for you; may Aditi, mother of gods, be well-being for you.

sanskrit: kalpetāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī kalpantām āpa oṣadhīḥ | kalpantām agnayaḥ sarve 'smai śraiṣṭhāya savratāḥ ||
english: May heaven and earth be well-ordered; may the waters and the plants be well-ordered; may all the fires, together in their shared vow, be well-ordered for this pre-eminence.

sanskrit: saṃ vaḥ sṛjāmi hṛdayaṃ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ mano astu vaḥ | saṃsṛṣṭā vas tanvaḥ santu saṃsṛṣṭaḥ prāṇo astu vaḥ ||
english: I unite your hearts; let your minds be united; let your bodies be united; let your breath of life be united.

sanskrit: saṃ vaḥ paśūnāṃ hṛdayaṃ sṛjāmi saṃ putrāṇām uta yā duhitaro vaḥ | saṃ vo jāyānāṃ manasā manāṃsi saṃ patīnām uta cakṣuḥ sṛjāmi ||
english: I unite the hearts of your cattle; I unite those of your sons and of your daughters; I unite the minds of your wives in harmony with their minds; I unite even the sight of your husbands.

sanskrit: prācī dig agnir adhipatir asito rakṣitādityā iṣavaḥ | tebhyo namo 'dhipatibhyo namo rakṣitṛbhyo nama iṣubhyo namo vo 'stu | yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmas taṃ vo jambhe dadhmas tam u prāṇo jahātu ||
english: The eastern quarter — Agni is its overlord, Asita its guardian, the Ādityas its arrows. Homage to those overlords, homage to those guardians, homage to those arrows, homage be to you. He who hates us, he whom we hate — him we place in your jaws; let the breath of life abandon him.

sanskrit: dakṣiṇā dig indro 'dhipatis tiraścirājī rakṣitā vasava iṣavaḥ | tebhyo namo 'dhipatibhyo namo rakṣitṛbhyo nama iṣubhyo namo vo 'stu | yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmas taṃ vo jambhe dadhmas tam u prāṇo jahātu ||
english: The southern quarter — Indra is its overlord, Tiraścirājī its guardian, the Vasus its arrows. Homage to those overlords, homage to those guardians, homage to those arrows, homage be to you. He who hates us, he whom we hate — him we place in your jaws; let the breath of life abandon him.

sanskrit: pratīcī dig varuṇo 'dhipatiḥ pṛdākū rakṣitā mitra iṣavaḥ | tebhyo namo 'dhipatibhyo namo rakṣitṛbhyo nama iṣubhyo namo vo 'stu | yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmas taṃ vo jambhe dadhmas tam u prāṇo jahātu ||
english: The western quarter — Varuṇa is its overlord, Pṛdākū its guardian, Mitra its arrows. Homage to those overlords, homage to those guardians, homage to those arrows, homage be to you. He who hates us, he whom we hate — him we place in your jaws; let the breath of life abandon him.

sanskrit: udīcī dik somo 'dhipatiḥ svajo rakṣitā vāta iṣavaḥ | tebhyo namo 'dhipatibhyo namo rakṣitṛbhyo nama iṣubhyo namo vo 'stu | yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmas taṃ vo jambhe dadhmas tam u prāṇo jahātu ||
english: The northern quarter — Soma is its overlord, Svaja its guardian, Vāta its arrows. Homage to those overlords, homage to those guardians, homage to those arrows, homage be to you. He who hates us, he whom we hate — him we place in your jaws; let the breath of life abandon him.

sanskrit: dhruvā dig viṣṇur adhipatiḥ kalmāṣagrīvo rakṣitā vīrudha iṣavaḥ | tebhyo namo 'dhipatibhyo namo rakṣitṛbhyo nama iṣubhyo namo vo 'stu | yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmas taṃ vo jambhe dadhmas tam u prāṇo jahātu ||
english: The fixed (nadir) quarter — Viṣṇu is its overlord, Kalmāṣagrīva its guardian, the plants its arrows. Homage to those overlords, homage to those guardians, homage to those arrows, homage be to you. He who hates us, he whom we hate — him we place in your jaws; let the breath of life abandon him.

sanskrit: ūrdhvā dig bṛhaspatir adhipatiś citro rakṣitāśanir iṣavaḥ | tebhyo namo 'dhipatibhyo namo rakṣitṛbhyo nama iṣubhyo namo vo 'stu | yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmas taṃ vo jambhe dadhmas tam u prāṇo jahātu ||
english: The upward quarter — Bṛhaspati is its overlord, Citra its guardian, the thunderbolt its arrows. Homage to those overlords, homage to those guardians, homage to those arrows, homage be to you. He who hates us, he whom we hate — him we place in your jaws; let the breath of life abandon him.
